finding: The bounded selected A13 query returns no source. Broader discovery queries return only legacy discovery rows, including known scalar/Hartree, finite-grid, or comparison materials; none supplies the current complex three-component A1 production generator together with a hash-pinned heat_root_incidence, root-labelled filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner and once-owned nonnegative q-ledger. The search therefore strengthens the R-192 owner stop but does not prove that no such source exists outside the bounded index.
decision_reason: A discovery hit is not a production owner. Promoting a legacy Model-A, Hartree, finite-grid, or gradient-flow statement would import its kinetic law, field space, regulator and normalization and would bypass the R-192 first-failure contract. The correct disposition is a bounded applicability stop, not a new physical negative.
boundary: This is T0 claim-nonbearing source-applicability evidence only. It does not refute QFT dynamics in general, close R-192, supply A13/T-050, prove an interacting measure, OS/KMS or real-time dynamics, select a physical vacuum, or close Sector-A/Pre-A. The result is limited to the current selected index and the stated bounded queries.
next_action: Keep the discovery-only source set quarantined. Advance only if a future authority supplies and hash-pins the A1 production generator/mobility, heat_root_incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial identity and one-use q-ledger; then rerun the unchanged R-192 owner order.
